reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: If your expecting the tops to properly screw on a provide anything resembling a seal to keep a liquid inside, save your self the frustration and buy something else. These are proof that you get what you pay for. Pictured are just three examples of how crooked the caps screw onto the bottles. I put water into four of them and three leaked.

reviews.t: These bottles are the perfect size for my travel needs
reviews.x: These bottles are the perfect size for my travel needs. Anything larger than 2oz seems excessive for travel. They do not leak and are solid construction. Should last a while.

Perfect ,nice quality ,durable, easy to use, Just what I wanted  for my traveling needs / 12 bottles great for my many items, Body wash, body lotion, shampoo, conditioner, face cream,  eve cream, perfume, sunscreen etc. AAAA+

reviews.t: Worked extremely well for all manner of toiletries on a ...
reviews.x: Worked extremely well for all manner of toiletries on a long trip. No leaking or problems, even with completely watery substances such as witch hazel.

reviews.t: Great Size! I love the bulk package as well.
reviews.x: I do a lot of traveling, and also take my toiletries to the gym each day. These bottles are the perfect size. The bottles are small enough to pack in a carry-on. I can fit a number of them, along with my other items, in the TSA required "quart sized bag." The fact that they come in a 12 pack also means I can pack some in my carry-on and put additional bottles in my checked luggage if I expect to need more than two ounces on a trip. I am really glad that I ordered these, and would recomme

Once you take the caps off you cannot get them back on. The caps seem too big for the bottle. When you can catch the threads, the cap is on an angle and is so flimsy my toddler got the cap off. I would not recommend these

reviews.t: Caps unscrew and the "click top" clicks open in your pocket
reviews.x: I had hoped to use these small bottles for hand sanitizer to keep in my pocket for use at the gym, supermarket etc. The size is fine, the problem is that the small "flip top" either unscrews or pops open in my pocket almost daily. I have tried horsing these tops down with a small plier and they still come loose. When I can get the top to stay in the place, the little "pop top" pops open and sanitizes my junk.  If you keep these bottle on a desk top or in a drawer, they should be fine. I do use t

reviews.t: Caps do not fit bottles correctly.
reviews.x: Very disappointed with this order.  The caps would not screw onto the bottle correctly.  Unfortunately I had to use them because I had already made a batch of lotion before I noticed the defects and had no other bottles.  Now I’m forced to sell lotion in bottles with milk unstable caps which I have to explain to every customer.  Please do some quality control on your products!

reviews.t: Good travel botttle for shampoo and conditioner
reviews.x: If you looking for a bottle to carry around then look no further. If you looking for a bottle that will get extensive use then keep looking further. The bottle walls feel as if they will crack after a lot of daily use. They will work well for traveling (shampoo) but not for every day hand sanitizers

I use these bottles for homeless outreach. I break down donated large bottles of shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and even laundry detergent into these smaller, portable bottles that are easier for the homeless to carry in their packs. The only warning I can give with them is that in intense heat (we live in central Arizona) the pop tops can pop up and the liquid can expand out.

reviews.t: Good quality, but will open in your luggage
reviews.x: Good quality, but the disc cap (push one edge to rock it back to expose opening) will open on its own in transit in your luggage, as pressure is exerted by your other stuff.  I put these in a plastic zip bag with paper towel to absorb leakage.
I would have given this a 5 star aside from the fact that 2 of these bottles came without the top part of the cap. Other than giving me two useless bottles they work well.
I needed bottles that will store glitter for use. These opaque bottles are ok but the opening is small and I would prefer clear. Better quality than I at first thought.

These work great. I have a special needs son that thinks he needs to use an entire bottle of shower gel for each shower so I got these and divided up the big bottle. Now he just grabs one small bottle and can use it all. We save money and he’s happy. It’s a win win.
I make my own essential oil lotions and these bottles are perfect! No leakage, cap stays on tight, easy to open/close.
These bottles are a great size to use for samples, via massage oils, etc.  I am pleased with them.
You're pretty small but they're perfect for travel and there easy to clean
Held mouthwash, shampoo, conditioner and body wash with no leaks.
I made hand sanitizers in these and they work GREAT!
Flexible bottles, easy to squeeze product out.
Well made and sturdy, very happy with them.

Classroom perfect! I teach Aesthetics. So I need massive amounts of disk tops bottles. I thought they were called pert top but they are not. Usually I can find them at any store locally but they were just nowhere to be found. I’m really happy with this purchase I will probably only ever purchased them again through Amazon.

These are horrible.  The size is great, the bottle itself is a nice size.  The lid doesn't fit at all.  Its supposed to screw on but doesn't screw on correctly.  Not even close to being straight.  Every leaks out because of this.  Terrible product.  If I could give half a star I would

Used two of these bottles on my last vacation.  The threads on the cap and bottle are not the same sizes and will not seal the bottles resulting in leaks. I even covered the openings with plastic wrap before I screwed the caps on and they still leaked.

Good seal. If I squeeze very very hard, then there is a little leakage. I use a couple bottles for hand sanitizer (transferred from a larger bottle). In the future I plan on using some for travel sundries

claims.text: Many reviewers find these bottles the perfect size for travel and report no leaking, even with watery liquids.
A common complaint is that the caps do not screw on correctly or stay on, with some caps being crooked, too big, or flimsy.
Some reviewers report that the flip/push caps pop open on their own in luggage or pockets, causing leakage.
Several reviewers praise the bottles as good quality and durable for travel use.
A few reviewers note issues such as missing cap parts or thin walls that may not hold up to extensive daily use.
